prompt: I'm the orchestrator. PR #142 (unit U2 of the rate-limit plan, dispatched to issue #87) was just merged. Bring me into the respond loop and mark the unit complete. Include the exact `gh` commands.
expected_output: The agent enters Phase 4 respond loop, picks 'Mark unit complete', closes issue #87 via `gh issue close`, and tells the user to archive the Conductor workspace at /Users/ryan/conductor/workspaces/api-gateway/jackson. Optionally posts a final comment summarizing the closeout.
expectations: The output uses `gh issue close 87` (or `gh issue close <num> --comment <closeout>`) to close the dispatched issue.
The output explicitly tells the user to archive the Conductor workspace at the worktree path (or remove it manually) — the skill cannot do this itself, but it must surface the instruction.

Before closing, the output verifies (via `gh pr view 142 --json state` or similar) that PR #142 is actually in `MERGED` state — it does NOT close the issue solely on the user's word, since user could be mistaken.
Any `gh pr list` or `gh pr view` includes the `--state all` flag if listing is involved (so merged PRs remain visible).
The output does NOT attempt to archive the Conductor workspace itself (Conductor archival is a manual user step), and does NOT delete the worktree directory.
